title: Junior Eduardo Garciavargas booked into Miami-Dade Corrections & Rehabilitation on Aug. 16 - North Miami-Dade News
text:
Junior Eduardo Garciavargas booked into Miami-Dade Corrections & Rehabilitation on Aug. 16
Junior Eduardo Garciavargas was booked into Miami-Dade Corrections & Rehabilitation, a jail in Miami-Dade County, Florida, on Sunday, Aug. 16, according to booking records.
The booking listed one charge, categorized as Drug. The listed charge was 'COC/SELL/POSS/W/INT.' No charge level was specified in the booking record.
Garciavargas had at least one prior booking.
